response.criticism:
The draft core design is substantially well-structured and addresses most fact-sheet requirements. However, seven material gaps and conflicts were identified across security, data-flow, technology conflicts, NFR coverage, and missing components:

1. TECH CONFLICT — ThreadPoolExecutor vs. Async LLM Dispatch: The architecture simultaneously proposes FastAPI (async-native) and ThreadPoolExecutor for LLM concurrency. ThreadPoolExecutor blocks the async event loop under I/O-bound LLM calls. The correct pattern for FastAPI is asyncio-native concurrency using asyncio.gather or a task queue (Celery/ARQ), not ThreadPoolExecutor. Retaining ThreadPoolExecutor negates the scalability benefit of FastAPI and Container Apps horizontal scaling.

2. TECH CONFLICT — Redis Cache for TF-IDF Pickle Artifacts: The design stores TF-IDF model artifacts in Redis using Python pickle serialisation. Pickle deserialisation of untrusted or corrupted cache entries is a known arbitrary code execution vector. For a governance tool handling enterprise uploads, this is a critical security gap. Artifacts should be serialised with joblib (scikit-learn native) and stored in Azure Blob Storage with SAS-token-gated access, not raw Redis pickle.

3. MISSING NFR — Input Schema Flexibility vs. Brittle Validation: The fact sheet explicitly flags brittleness against non-conforming uploads as a pain point. The proposed solution enforces strict Table and Field schema validation (Phase 1) but defers the SPA-side column mapping UI to a risk mitigation note only. A column-mapping/normalisation step must be a first-class architecture component in the data flow, not just a risk note, otherwise the brittleness pain point is not resolved architecturally.

4. MISSING COMPONENT — No File Upload Security Scanning: The fact sheet NFR explicitly requires file upload sanitisation to prevent malicious file injection. The design mentions validation but does not include a dedicated file scanning/sanitisation component (e.g., antivirus scan, MIME-type enforcement, file size cap, macro stripping for Excel). This must be an explicit pipeline step between API Gateway receipt and backend processing.

5. MISSING NFR — Single Point of Failure on Python Backend: The NFR section claims horizontal scaling via Container Apps, but the architecture diagram shows a single python_backend component with no mention of stateless design enforcement, session affinity risks, or how the Redis TF-IDF cache is shared across multiple backend instances. If TF-IDF cache is in-process memory (as the data_store description ambiguously states 'memory or blob storage'), horizontal scaling will cause cache misses and per-request refitting on non-primary instances, defeating the caching goal entirely. The cache must be explicitly externalised to a shared Redis or Blob tier accessible by all backend replicas.

6. MISSING COMPONENT — No Async Job / Response Pattern for Long-Running Analysis: For datasets approaching 1000 attributes, pairwise comparison generates up to ~500,000 pairs. The 30-second Excel export SLA is at risk under synchronous REST. The architecture has no async job pattern (e.g., job ID returned immediately, polling endpoint, or webhook) to handle long-running analyses without HTTP timeout failures. This is a critical omission for the stated performance NFR.

7. MISSING NFR — Data Residency for LLM Inference: The open questions section raises data residency concerns about attribute data sent to the Azure-hosted Llama-3.3-70B endpoint, but the architecture makes no provision for this. Given enterprise governance context, the architecture must explicitly document that the LLM endpoint is within the enterprise Azure tenant boundary, or provide a fallback path (e.g., prompt contains only anonymised pair identifiers, not raw field names) if cross-boundary data transfer is prohibited. This must be an architectural constraint, not just an open question.

architecture.backend: Python FastAPI backend on Azure Container Apps using asyncio-native async/await for LLM I/O; ThreadPoolExecutor retained only for CPU-bound similarity scoring (scikit-learn TF-IDF, Levenshtein, Jaccard); async job queue (ARQ or Celery with Redis broker) introduced for long-running analyses exceeding 30-second HTTP timeout threshold
architecture.data_store: Externalised shared Redis Cache (Azure Cache for Redis) for TF-IDF artifact storage using joblib serialisation (not pickle); Azure Blob Storage for durable artifact persistence; Azure SQL for audit trail; all backend replicas share the same Redis and Blob tier to support stateless horizontal scaling

components.label: User / Client
components.name: Enterprise Governance User Browser
components.role: Entry point for BI analysts and data stewards uploading attribute files and reviewing results

components.label: SPA Frontend
components.name: Static Single-Page Application
components.role: Renders drag-and-drop upload, column-mapping normalisation UI, tabbed report cards, filterable tables, job status polling, and Excel export UI
components.technology: HTML5, Bootstrap 5.3.3, Custom CSS, JavaScript ES6, SheetJS

components.label: API Gateway / Auth
components.name: Azure API Management with SSO Enforcement
components.role: Enforces authentication, authorisation, rate limiting, and CORS/CSP policy on all backend API calls
components.technology: Azure API Management, Azure AD, OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS 1.3

components.label: File Sanitisation Layer
components.name: Upload Validation and Sanitisation Service
components.role: Enforces MIME-type whitelist (xlsx, csv only), file size cap, macro/embedded-object stripping for Excel, and malicious content scanning before any processing occurs
components.technology: Python python-magic MIME detection, openpyxl macro stripping, file size enforcement, ClamAV or Azure Defender for Storage scan trigger

components.label: Column Mapper
components.name: Input Schema Normalisation Component
components.role: Detects uploaded column headers and maps non-conforming schemas to required Table and Field canonical columns via configurable mapping rules; returns descriptive errors for unmappable uploads
components.technology: Python, Pydantic schema validation, fuzzy column header matching, SPA-side column mapping confirmation UI

components.label: Python Backend
components.name: Python Async REST Backend Service
components.role: Exposes /find_overlaps (sync small datasets) and /find_overlaps/async (job-based large datasets) endpoints; orchestrates file sanitisation, column mapping, similarity pipeline, LLM batching, caching, and audit persistence
components.technology: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn, asyncio, ARQ or Celery task queue, pandas

components.label: Async Job Queue
components.name: Long-Running Analysis Job Queue
components.role: Accepts analysis jobs exceeding synchronous timeout threshold; returns job ID immediately; SPA polls /jobs/{id}/status endpoint; prevents HTTP timeout failures for large datasets
components.technology: ARQ (asyncio Redis Queue) or Celery with Redis broker; Azure Cache for Redis as broker backend

components.label: Similarity Engine
components.name: Hybrid Similarity Scoring Pipeline
components.role: Computes TF-IDF cosine (45%), Levenshtein edit distance (25%), and Jaccard trigram (30%) scores for attribute pairs using cached vectorizer artifacts from shared Redis/Blob store
components.technology: scikit-learn TF-IDF, python-Levenshtein, custom Jaccard trigram, NumPy, joblib serialisation

components.label: LLM Service
components.name: Azure Llama-3.3-70B Inference Service
components.role: Confirms high-confidence attribute overlaps above 0.95 threshold via batched async LLM prompts; endpoint must reside within enterprise Azure tenant boundary to satisfy data residency requirements
components.technology: AzureOpenAI async Python SDK, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, API version 2024-05-01-preview, asyncio.gather concurrency, exponential backoff with jitter

components.label: Secrets Store
components.name: Azure Key Vault Secrets Manager
components.role: Stores and serves LLM API credentials, endpoint URLs, and Redis connection strings securely at runtime via Managed Identity; no credentials in source code or environment variable plaintext
components.technology: Azure Key Vault, Managed Identity, Azure SDK

components.label: Cache Store
components.name: Shared External TF-IDF Artifact Cache
components.role: Stores fitted TF-IDF vectorizer artifacts serialised with joblib; shared across all stateless backend replicas to eliminate per-request refitting; cache key derived from dataset vocabulary hash; TTL-governed with manual flush endpoint
components.technology: Azure Cache for Redis, joblib serialisation, vocabulary-hash cache keys, configurable TTL

components.label: Audit Store
components.name: Persistent Audit Data Store
components.role: Persists all historical overlap analysis results with user identity, timestamp, and dataset metadata for governance evidence and compliance reporting; data classified and encrypted at rest
components.technology: Azure SQL Database, row-level security, Azure SQL Transparent Data Encryption, Azure SQL data masking

components.label: Blob Store
components.name: Azure Blob Storage for Artifacts and Exports
components.role: Durable storage for serialised TF-IDF model artifacts and generated Excel export files; SAS-token-gated access; no public blob access
components.technology: Azure Blob Storage, SAS tokens, Managed Identity access, private endpoints
